notes: Status LEDs are now enabled in the official firmware: the red/green LEDs alternate for 3 seconds at power-on, blink green for 3 seconds when the screen connects over Bluetooth, and blink red for 3 seconds before an intentional shutdown. The lines are only ever pulled low or released (never driven high) and the animations never block weighing or Bluetooth. The LEDs are powered from USB, so nothing lights on battery alone. The charger-status reading through the shared pins stays off for now. Calibration, the stored calibration factor, TARE, battery saving, BLE and updates are unchanged.
